en: Dependent on a state that is not fixed in wrongness (*micchatta-niyata*) … dependent on a state that is not fixed in rightness (*sammatta-niyata*) … dependent on a state that is not fixed (*aniyata*) … (Abbreviated.

Under the root condition (*hetu*), twenty-nine; under the object condition (*ārammaṇa*), twenty-four … under the result condition (*vipāka*), nine … under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), twenty-nine.
